question: Does LiteInst flat-fork L2 support extend to a nested tree where a fork-child both forks a grandchild and waits on it (a mid-tree non-root parent-waiter)?
answer: No. Mid-tree non-root parent-waiter deadlocks LiteInst at teardown; golden ptrace backend runs the identical tree at L2. Gap = non-root wait4/reap mediation (owner-gated lifecycle change).
evidence: logs/liteinst_nested_min_deadlock.detcore.txt (tree [3 [5 [6]]], run-queue stall, dtid3 wait4 / dtid5 ParentContinue(5->6) / dtid6 Exit not committing)
